current.text: Goodwin re-signed with Phoenix for 3 years and 19 million USD.
Both experts call the contract a steal or undervalued.
He is probably in the Phoenix rotation as the fourth or fifth guard.
The Phoenix backcourt is crowded. Devin Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks and Collin Gillespie will all want touches.
Tier 9 point guard. He is a 16-team league player who is only possibly worth considering in 12-team leagues.

durable.text: His category value comes mainly from steals and few turnovers. He scores little and his FG% is below average.
